isolation: fresh temporary LOCI_BASE_DIR for each replay

legacy_long_reference_after.phase: preliminary all-branches priority proof retained before representative-path narrowing

review_regressions.single_neighbor_admission: The priority and later ordinary stages reuse one admitted neighborhood per node; a max_neighbors=1 fixture admits Binding and never later admits Clock.
review_regressions.failed_transition: A stale first-edge proof does not mark the transition successful and the downstream Options-to-Binding edge is absent.
review_regressions.typescript_role: A bounded stored signature is parsed once per selected callable. Structural parameter-field spans include ActualInput while excluding a same-context generic ConstraintPayload and a function-body local annotation.
review_regressions.representative_path: Each callable promotes one deterministic authored input/dependency path. The pressure fixture then delivers both forward body-call and reverse caller controls before remaining ordinary type branches.

coverage_limit: The current index proves direct parameter types with context=annotation. TypeScript declarations whose bounded first-line stored signature cannot structurally prove the parameter field, and nested generic type_argument records that do not encode parameter-versus-return ownership, remain ordinary edges.
